## Constant On-Time Lab initial build

### Included

- local-first application and 17 engineering labs
- deterministic simulation core and analytical validation
- Modules 0–12, source library, and study aids
- progressive PSpice ladder with honest validation status
- unit, browser, accessibility, visual, offline, link, and security checks

### Review gates

- [ ] `npm run verify:static`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run check:offline`
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e`
- [ ] source-link workflow
- [ ] security workflow
- [ ] repository visibility verified private
- [ ] PSpice status still says NOT RUN unless execution evidence is attached
